notes.title: Lunacid: Tears of Moon Release
notes.notes:
Hello!

Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is now available for free on Steam. It’s a Lunacid spin-off made with the Sword of Moonlight — a toolkit from 2000 used to create King’s Field like games that was released by FROMSOFT. After all, a lot of inspiration for the original Lunacid stems from my deep appreciation of Shadow Tower and King’s Field games. 

[previewyoutube=c_Wf55uc5Vs;full][/previewyoutube]

Tears of the Moon is also a dark fantasy dungeon crawler — full of daunting foes, spells and weapons to obtain and, of course, secrets to discover. The game is very much worth trying out, if you never got to experience the KF series, or feel nostalgic about games of that era.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3506110/Lunacid__Tears_of_the_Moon/ 

Naturally, a tool straight from the year 2000 is bound to have a fair share of limitations. However, I very much enjoyed challenging myself to be more creative within these constraints. And I hope, that you could appreciate both this passion and FROMSOFT’s legacy in Lunacid: Tears of the Moon.

Thank you for your support.
Moonlight watch thee.

notes.title: Lunacid's Halloween update brings jack-o-lanterns to Wing's Rest, but most importantly a number of bug fixes and an update on language localization
notes.notes:
Dark and dingy fantasy dungeon crawler Lunacid has adorned its halls just in time for Halloween, and as a fantasy-loving Halloween fanatic, this is great news for me. Even though the game is already brimming with ghosts and ghouls, KIRA LLC has cut no corners in bringing even more decor to Wing's Rest to help every player celebrate the season, and anyone who feels the same about pumpkins and thematic lighting will probably be just as excited as I am...
                Read more.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

October is already here, and you know what this means — all manners of scares and seasonal decorations crop up all over the place. You might be surprised, but the denizens of the Wing’s Rest are no exception to this!

Halloween in Lunacid
Wing’s Rest is now adorned with lots of jack-o-lanterns and couple of other furnishings. Now the mellow blues and serenity of the abandoned shrine is punctuated with mischievous flicker of orange flames.

https://i.imgur.com/IwjPT7E.gif

But not only that, Wing’s Rest also received a slight lighting improvements for the base version as well. Speaking of, this update brings some more improvements and fixes.
Patch Notes 
 
 Wand projectiles change colors according to element.
 Light Reveal is more helpful.
 Fixed Useable Items equipping wrong slot when used.
 Fixed Critical hit effect position.
 Fixed Garrat not moving without reloading.
 Fixed menu bugs.
 Tried to fix projectile accuracy.
 Slightly improved lighting in Wing’s Rest.
 Fixed Backwards Khopesh.
 Added Halloween items.
 Added more character portraits.
 Made the main menu look better.

Lunar Divination
We’d like to give a brief update on the new languages and Steam Trading cards we teased in June of this year.

First of all — localization process is its finale phase, the in-game testing. Since Lunacid features quite a bit of text written in a lot of different formats (item and spell descriptions, menus, dialogues, notes) we need to make sure that everything looks similar to the baseline English version in terms of visual presentation and clarity. It might take a bit more time, but don’t worry — the localization update is closer than you think.

As for the Steam Trading cards — these are almost ready, actually! Hopefully we can release them this month, if everything gets approved by Valve. Don’t forget to check out the full-sized card arts when they drop, as they’re not simply “small art now big”. 

Once again, thank you so much for all your support and love. And remember, the Moon has its phases, and the story of Lunacid isn’t quite over just yet.

Moonlight watch thee.

Wow this game is broken, and it all falls on me. I seriously had a bunch of bugs because sometimes I called a class Royal and sometimes Royalty.

notes.title: Lunacid Version 1.0 is released!
notes.notes:
Full patch notes will be attached at the bottom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41193816/568745b7eeef44b82c2cd3091a2108392883c72b.png

As Halloween descends upon us, we have finally left Early Access. The game is now feature and level complete with a new coat of polish. I couldn’t not have made the game this nice without all the feedback and testing from the Early Access players, thank you all so much!

There’s still bound to be more bug patches in the future, but mostly I’ll be working on localization in the future. There’s a prequel also in the works, on the old Sword of Moonlight engine, that I’ll give more details on later when it’s closer to completion.

Thank you all so much for the amazing support you’ve given me over the years!

notes.title: Castle Update in Beta
notes.notes:
New Castle Update out in open beta

I have released the new update featuring the castle area in the open beta branch. If all goes well then it will release to the public branch in a few days.

To get to the beta branch, right click the game in the steam library and select betas, you should see one labeled open-beta.

But please know that this branch is more likely to have bugs and more experimental/unbalanced content.
